elements.content: Once upon a time, there was a thief who saw a doorbell hanging on the neighbor’s door. He wanted to steal it. But he knew the bell would ring as soon as he touched it, and then he would be discovered. He thought, “Only using ears can one hear the sound. What if I cover my ears? Then the sound would not be heard anymore.” So he covered his own ears and tried to steal the bell. However, he was discovered immediately when he touched the bell.

elements.content:

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

child_list.content: 掩耳盗铃
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content: 从前，有一个小偷看到邻居家的门上挂着一个门铃。他想偷它。但他知道，他知道只要一碰，铃铛就会响起来，然后他就会被发现。他想：“只有耳朵能听见声音。如果我捂住耳朵呢？那么声音就不会被听见了。”于是他捂住自己的耳朵，试图偷门铃。然而，当他触摸到门铃时，他立刻就被发现了。

child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
